content.instruction: Email Dana to tell her that the meeting has moved to Thursday.
content.context: The user asked: “email dana that the meeting moved to thursday and then check if room four b is free.” This task covers only the email to Dana; the room-four-B check is outside this task.
constraints: Confirm with the user before sending the email.
Do not send the email without user confirmation.
Do not perform the room-four-B availability check as part of this task.
success_criteria: The user has confirmed the email should be sent.
An email is sent to Dana stating that the meeting moved to Thursday.
No room availability check is performed as part of this task.
open_questions: What was the meeting’s original day/time, if that should be included?
What time on Thursday is the meeting?
Which Dana and which email address should be used?
What exact wording should the email use?
Should the email be sent immediately after confirmation?
